entries.back_en: "What do ye do in this place?"
"And...What is your purpose against this dragon?"
entries.note: 'design for'→'propósito contra' adds slight antagonism but context-appropriate.

entries.back_en: "Do ye believe ye can do such a thing? Ye are but mortals."
"Ye do not understand the power of that which thou wouldst destroy. This is a dragon."
entries.note: Mixes 'compreendeis'(vós) with 'procurarías'(tu), mirroring source thou/you mix; note typo 'procurarías'.

entries.back_en: "A dragon is a force of nature in itself. Ye may try to fight a volcano or the earth itself! Dragons give birth to your people, grant you life, and surely take it away. To them ye are as ye are to an insect. In your terms..."
"'Tis as I supposed... It is not mortals' nature to change their ways..."
